title: Coherence criterion for finite constructible sheaves of sets on a vanishing topos
statement: Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme, meaning locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], let $f:X\to S$ be of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $A$ be a sheaf of sets on the vanishing topos $V_f=X_{\mathrm{Et}}\overleftarrow\times_{S_{\mathrm{Et}}}S_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-trf-oriented-nearby-cycles]. Then $A$ is a coherent object of $V_f$ [def-trf-coherent-topos] if and only if there are finite stratifications $X=\coprod_\alpha X_\alpha$ and $S=\coprod_\beta S_\beta$ [def-constructible-stratification], each stratum constructible as a subset [def-weil-constructible-subset], such that for all $\alpha,\beta$ the inverse image of $A$ along the morphism $P_{\alpha\beta}=(X_\alpha)_{\mathrm{Et}}\overleftarrow\times_{S_{\mathrm{Et}}}(S_\beta)_{\mathrm{Et}}\to V_f$ given by [lem-trf-oriented-product-universal] from the projections, the stratum immersions and the oriented $2$-morphism is locally constant with finite set values: there is a covering family $(U_i)$ of the final object of $P_{\alpha\beta}$ such that on each slice topos $P_{\alpha\beta}/U_i$ the restricted sheaf is isomorphic to the constant sheaf $\underline{M_i}$ on a finite set $M_i$.

source.place: Author draft, §8.1, printed pp. 17–18, coherence criterion for sheaves of sets on oriented products; finite-presentation Noetherian specialization
